failure_partial_apply_behavior: Cloudflare D1 migrations apply per-file in lexical order; a failure stops the sequence at the failing file. Each migration runs in its own transaction; partial apply leaves earlier migrations committed. Integrity assertions in 0084/0087 RAISE(ROLLBACK) within the migration's temp assertion table at apply time.
drift_detection: No automated drift detection. Operator workflow: bunx wrangler d1 migrations list ARCH_DB --remote; compare to ls migrations/*.sql.
